angle_name: Zero-face reduction: Mellin transfer of the Abel sum to a mollifier-at-zeros amplitude sum, with discrete-moment control over zeros replacing recombination over d
mechanism: Step 1 (exact, unconditional): de-floor the Abel sum at cost O(K)=O(√x) since |R(⌊x/d⌋)−R(x/d)| ≪ 1 per term. Step 2: convert π−Li to ψ−id via R(t) = (ψ(t)−t)/log t + ∫_2^t (ψ(u)−u)/(u log²u) du − (1/2)π(t^{1/2}) + O(t^{1/3}); the −(1/2)π(√·) term rearranges exactly to (1/2)[M(K)π(x^{1/4}) + Σ_{x^{1/4}<p≤√x} M(⌊x/p²⌋)] and is bounded unconditionally (no RH-strength M input) by x^{3/4}exp(−c(log x)^{3/5}(loglog x)^{−1/3}). Step 3: Perron/Mellin representation of Σ_{d≤K} μ(d)(ψ(x/d)−x/d)/log(x/d) with generating series M_K(s)·(−ζ'/ζ)(s), M_K(s)=Σ_{d≤K}μ(d)d^{−s}; shift the contour past the zeros to obtain the exact zero-face S(x) = −Σ_{|γ|≤T} A_K(ρ,x)·x^ρ/ρ + O(x^{1/2}log²x + x·log²x/T + x^{3/4}exp(−c(log x)^{3/5−ε})), where A_K(ρ,x) = Σ_{d≤K} μ(d)d^{−ρ}/log(x/d) is the truncated-inverse-zeta (mollifier) amplitude evaluated at each zero ρ = β+iγ. Step 4 (the actual attack surface, UNVERIFIED): bound the zero sum not term-by-term but via unconditional discrete moments of the mollifier over zeros — Σ_{|γ|≤T} |A_K(ρ,x)|² computed by Gonek–Landau-type formulas, whose engine is the rigidity M_K(ρ)ζ(ρ) = 1 + E_K(ρ) with E_K(ρ) = −1 exactly at every zero — combined with the Vinogradov–Korobov zero-free region and Ingham–Huxley zero density for the x^β weights. The μ×R sign interaction survives as the evaluation of the Möbius polynomial at the points where ζ vanishes; it is never destroyed by a mean-square-over-d split. Honest ceiling: without new zero information this face cannot beat VK shape x·exp(−c(log x)^{3/5−ε}); rung 2 on this face is verbatim RH restated, and I claim only the reduction plus a rung-0 attempt.
new_leverage: Three items, all marked UNVERIFIED as capabilities. (1) The exact constraint E_K(ρ) = Σ_{n>K}(Σ_{d|n,d≤K}μ(d))n^{−ρ} = −1 at EVERY zero — a rigid, non-averaged identity coupling the truncated Möbius polynomial to zero locations, which no mean-square-over-d argument sees; it is the algebraic form of the μ×R sign interaction on this face. (2) Recombination happens over zeros, not over d: Cauchy–Schwarz is applied to Σ_γ A_K(ρ)x^{iγ}/ρ against the discrete second moment Σ_γ|A_K(ρ)|², an object with fifty years of unconditional Levinson/Conrey/Gonek technology behind it, structurally outside the audited 𝔉-class whose only input is Σ M(d)². (3) The face is exactly pointwise in x — the contour identity holds at the pinned, arithmetically synchronized x with no exceptional-set averaging — and it quantitatively predicts the observed flat 0.35–0.43 cancellation coefficient from the lowest zeros, making the mechanism numerically falsifiable at the pinned points.
target_estimate: Zero-face bound (new named face, proposed): with y ≍ √x, K = ⌊x/(y+1)⌋, ρ = β+iγ running over nontrivial zeros of ζ, and A_K(ρ,x) = Σ_{d≤K} μ(d) d^{−ρ}/log(x/d): |Σ_{|γ|≤T} A_K(ρ,x)·x^ρ/ρ| ≪_ε x^{1/2+ε} for T = x, together with the unconditional Reduction Lemma |S(x) + Σ_{|γ|≤T} A_K(ρ,x)x^ρ/ρ| ≪ x^{1/2}log²x + (x/T)log²x + x^{3/4}exp(−c(log x)^{3/5}(loglog x)^{−1/3}), where S(x) = Σ_{d≤K} μ(d)R(⌊x/d⌋). Losses: the π→ψ conversion carries the unconditional x^{3/4}·exp(−c(log x)^{3/5−ε}) term (removable only with sub-scale M-bounds I decline as circular); Perron truncation costs x log²x/T; floors cost O(√x). The rung-2 statement on this face is RH-equivalent — attacked only at rung 0 via discrete moments.

obstacle_positions.F_closure: Exits the class by construction, I claim (UNVERIFIED as a capability, verifiable as a syntactic fact): the only Mertens-type input is M_K(s) evaluated at complex points, never Σ M(d)²; recombination is over zeros, not over d; the sign interaction survives as A_K(ρ) with the exact constraint E_K(ρ) = −1. Caveat honestly stated: if the discrete moment Σ_γ|A_K(ρ)|² is itself only controllable through a mean-square-over-d step, the argument re-enters 𝔉 through the back door — this is the audit point.
obstacle_positions.fiber_growth: Sidestepped, not solved. No pair-to-modulus transfer, no additive characters, no shared reduced denominators anywhere; the off-diagonal lives in the zero-pair terms x^{i(γ−γ')} of the discrete second moment, governed by zero-correlation, not fiber combinatorics.
obstacle_positions.pinned_vs_averaged: Respected. The contour identity is exact and pointwise at the pinned x; the only averaging is over zeros (internal to the amplitude sum), never over x, so no exceptional-set risk at the synchronized point. This is a genuine strength of the Mellin face.
obstacle_positions.modulus_magnitude: Not applicable. No wheel modulus enters; the frequency parameter is the zero height gamma up to T = x, all conductors archimedean.
obstacle_positions.parity: Not a sieve; mu enters linearly through M_K(s), so the classical parity wall is not the binding constraint. The honest reincarnation of the difficulty is zero-location: on this face every hard question becomes where are the zeros and how big is the mollifier there, which is the correct (RH-hard) barrier, stated without disguise.
obstacle_positions.circularity: The binding obstacle, confronted explicitly. The zero sum contains the d=1 term, so bounding it at x^{1/2+eps} without zero information IS RH; hypothetical zeros with beta > 1/2 contribute x^beta A_K(rho) and the trivial |A_K| <= K^(1-beta) makes term-by-term treatment WORSE than triangle (per-zero sqrt(x)*(sqrt x)^beta, half the zero-free-region savings). I use no pointwise RH-strength bound anywhere: the pi(sqrt .) conversion term is bounded by unconditional VK-strength M(u) only — I explicitly decline the tempting M(u) << u^(1/2+eps) sub-scale induction because the kernel chain (target implies RH) does not license it. Conditional computations (RH implies zero-face << sqrt(x) polylog) are used solely as consistency checks, never as progress.
obstacle_positions.finite_range: The lens explains rather than trusts the calibration: flatness of |S|/sqrt(sum R²) at 0.35-0.43 is what a zero-sum dominated by the lowest ~100 zeros with slowly varying A_K(rho,x) predicts, and the same explicit-formula regime is exactly what misled Mertens — off-line zeros or slow A_K growth would only surface far beyond 10^9. Numerics are used here only to KILL (see kill test), never to promote.

kill_test: Pointwise prediction test, one afternoon of compute: for the existing sampled x up to 10^9, compute P_N(x) = −2√x·Re Σ_{0<γ≤γ_N} A_K(ρ,x)e^{iγ log x}/ρ (RH-verified zeros in this range, legitimate for a kill test) with N = 100 and N = 1000 zeros, plus the elementary secondary terms from Step 2, and compare against the recorded S(x) values. Kill condition A: if P_N(x) fails to track S(x) pointwise (correlation collapsing, or discrepancy not shrinking as N grows), the main-term identification is wrong and the angle dies. Kill condition B (kills the rung-0 plan specifically): numerically evaluate M_K(σ_0+it) − 1/ζ(σ_0+it) on the Vinogradov–Korobov contour for the same x; if this truncation error dominates |1/ζ| for t well below the needed Perron height T, the contour route cannot beat the trivial triangle bound and rung 0 via this face is dead.
rung0_plan: Phase 1 (bounded effort, weeks): prove the Reduction Lemma unconditionally — floors O(√x), π→ψ conversion with the exact M(⌊x/p²⌋) rearrangement and VK-strength M bounds, smoothed Perron, contour shift to the VK boundary σ_0(t) = 1 − c/((log t)^{2/3}(loglog t)^{1/3}). Phase 2: on the VK contour write M_K(s) = 1/ζ(s) + (M_K − 1/ζ)(s), bound 1/ζ and ζ'/ζ by (log t)^{2/3+ε} (VK), bound the truncation error by partial summation from the unconditional M(u) ≪ u·exp(−c(log u)^{3/5−ε}), and optimize T against the Perron error. Deliverable is two-sided by design: either an unconditional bound o(trivial) — the honest trivial scale being x log x·exp(−c·2^{−3/5}(log x)^{3/5}(loglog x)^{−1/3}) from triangle+PNT at the worst point x/K ≈ √x, which the aggregated contour can beat because it runs VK savings at full log x rather than log√x, IF the truncation-error term survives the T-balancing (constant-chasing, outcome genuinely uncertain, kill condition B decides) — or a documented obstruction note identifying the exact term that forces parity between contour and triangle, which is itself program-valuable audit material.
plausible_partial: Named: Zero-Face Reduction Lemma (unconditional). S(x) = −Σ_{|γ|≤T} A_K(ρ,x)x^ρ/ρ + O(x^{1/2}log²x + (x/T)log²x + x^{3/4}exp(−c(log x)^{3/5}(loglog x)^{−1/3})), fully classical explicit-formula technology, provable at bounded effort, and formalization-friendly in structure (finite sums, explicit contours). Value to the program even if rung 0 fails: it adds a third kernel-equivalent-up-to-PNT-error face of the target — the zeros face — on which the obstacle set is disjoint from both the Abel and quadratic-form faces (no fibers, no wheel modulus, pinned-x exact), and it upgrades the calibration numerics from descriptive to predictive via the kill test. Secondary partial, also bounded effort: the exact rearrangement identity Σ_{d≤K}μ(d)π(√(x/d)) = M(K)π(x^{1/4}) + Σ_{x^{1/4}<p≤√x} M(⌊x/p²⌋), a clean standalone lemma the Lean track could take now.
self_assessed_risk: Weakest assumption, stated plainly: that unconditional discrete moments of the mollifier over zeros (Gonek–Landau/Levinson machinery) can control Σ_γ A_K(ρ,x)x^{iγ} better than the trivial per-zero bound WITHOUT re-entering the 𝔉-class or smuggling zero-location information — every known unconditional version of these formulas carries x^β weights that hand the problem back to zero density, so the rung-2 face is RH restated and I do not claim otherwise. Risk breakdown: Reduction Lemma — low risk, high confidence provable. Kill test prediction matching — moderate risk (secondary-term bookkeeping is fiddly at 10^6–10^9). Rung 0 strict o(trivial) — high risk; the M_K − 1/ζ truncation error on the VK contour may force T so small that only the trivial shape with a worse constant survives (kill condition B); I estimate under 50 percent that rung 0 in the strict sense lands. Rung 1 (x^{3/4}) via this lens alone — effectively unreachable: it would need density estimates at quasi-RH strength; anyone claiming otherwise through this face is bounding zeros and should say so. Net honest claim: this lens is a reformulation-and-audit instrument with a real but modest shot at rung 0, not a route to the target.
